body.heading: Where in the world is Lesotho?
paragraphs: Lesotho is a country in Southern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Lesotho is Maseru.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Lesotho speak Southern Sotho and English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Lesotho is the Lesotho loti.

body.heading: How big is Lesotho?
paragraphs: Lesotho covers about 30,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Togo.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: One of Africa's highest single-drop waterfalls, Maletsunyane plunges nearly 200 metres into a gorge. Adventurous families can even abseil down beside it — one of the longest abseils in the world.
The Sani Pass is a zigzag mountain road climbing into the Drakensberg. At the top sits a famous mountain-top pub and views that stretch for miles.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Lesotho on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
